actual Claude CLI behavior and terminal command, overriding the swapped task label metadata

ownerDisposition.finding: Missing runtime evidence was fabricated as stopped/fresh and Registration updatedAt was fabricated as Execution last-good evidence.
ownerDisposition.repair: Monitor, Forwarder, and Execution projections now remain unknown with no observedAt or lastGoodAt until authoritative runtime evidence exists; PostgreSQL integration covers desired-off missing evidence.

ownerDisposition.finding: Delivery retry did not fence on current executionEnabled and could be accepted before the router ignored it.
ownerDisposition.repair: Retry now locks and checks enabled, executionEnabled, and version, persists an execution_disabled rejection and audit, and the dashboard disables retry when execution is disabled.

ownerDisposition.finding: Retry idempotency was scoped per delivery while command identity was global.
ownerDisposition.repair: Retry request locking and durable response storage use the global delivery:retry scope, so one key reused for another delivery conflicts before mutation.

ownerDisposition.finding: The dashboard verified only an accepted attempt ID after retry.
ownerDisposition.repair: Authoritative verification now binds response and re-query delivery identity, Registration identity/version, route-attempt floor, accepted attempt observed-attempt fence, and current durable delivery state.

ownerDisposition.finding: Mutation-time 401 and network failures left connected state and mutation controls enabled.
ownerDisposition.repair: A shared operational failure classifier now invalidates memory-only CSRF state on 401 and marks store/network failures disconnected across create/update/disable/delivery/retry paths.

ownerDisposition.finding: Healthy queued and leased Queue states were classified as divergent using Execution vocabulary.
ownerDisposition.repair: Backend sorting and browser filtering now use component-specific desired and stopped vocabularies; queued and leased are healthy desired Queue states.

ownerDisposition.finding: The webhook route was dispatched before exact Host enforcement.
ownerDisposition.repair: Exact configured Host is enforced before webhook signature parsing or persistence, with a valid-signature wrong-Host regression test.

ownerDisposition.finding: Design-gate reconciliation searched unrelated global path/method substrings and ignored x-designflow-capability.
ownerDisposition.repair: The startup gate parses exact OpenAPI method/path operations and requires the operation's x-designflow-capability to equal the reconciled capability.

ownerDisposition.finding: The dashboard stayed two-column through 767px and the details summary target was only about 22px.
ownerDisposition.repair: The single-column breakpoint is 767px and details summary is an aligned 44px minimum target, both measured in headless Chromium.

ownerDisposition.finding: Repository uniqueness conflict omitted the existing Registration identity.
ownerDisposition.repair: Create uses conflict-safe lookup and the 409 structured outcome returns the existing Registration ID/version fence and ETag.

ownerDisposition.finding: Session creation and bootstrap rejection lacked complete audit.
ownerDisposition.repair: Session creation fails closed unless runtime audit persists; creation, logout, expiry, bootstrap and browser-boundary rejections record actor/reason/request metadata without token, session ID, or CSRF proof.

ownerDisposition.finding: Healthy queued and leased Queue states were classified as anomalies.
ownerDisposition.repair: The shared component-specific vocabulary repair covers backend and browser anomaly behavior.

ownerDisposition.finding: The light-surface eyebrow color failed WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
ownerDisposition.repair: Light surfaces use #365d62 at 7.24:1 on white and at least 6.47:1 on the other approved light surfaces; the dark topbar retains its distinct light label color.

ownerDisposition.finding: Pure unknown anomalies matched none of the exposed filters.
ownerDisposition.repair: Pure unknown remains visibly actual: unknown and maps into the approved divergent count/filter and legend, preserving the exact failed/disconnected/stale/divergent element contract.
